editorial:
Ever feel like your coworkers are just too much to handle? You will totally relate to Orson, a guy who just wants some peace and quiet. He finds a hidden corner office that seems to be empty, and he starts sneaking away there to escape the noise and drama of his boring job. It starts off as a funny look at office life, but things get weird fast. The vibe is kind of like a dream where everything feels a bit off, and you will find yourself wondering why everyone is so stressed out about a simple room.

The acting is great because it captures that awkward feeling of working in a cubicle. The twists are what really keep you watching, as the story shifts from a joke into a strange mystery. While the pace starts slow, the payoff is worth it. If you like movies that make you think and then surprise you, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or if you prefer renting on Apple TV, that works too. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a solid move.
endingExplained: You eventually find out that the corner office is not actually a room in the building. It is a place where people go when they are dead or slipping away from reality. Orson discovers that he has actually passed away, and the office is a waiting room before he moves on. The movie ends with him finally accepting his fate and leaving the corporate world behind for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves office humor and strange plot twists.
